The handle is black, likely plastic or composite, attached to the tang with visible rivets. The lighting creates a metallic sheen on the blade surface.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomy of the knife and distinguish it from similar kitchen knives like chef's knives or santokus.
To analyze the legibility and structural integrity of the text/logo on the blade, checking for AI-generated gibberish.
To verify the physical connectivity of the rivets to the handle and tang, ensuring they are not floating or fused artifacts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the blade. AI models often struggle with small, curved, or reflective surface text. Verify if the 'brand' is real or hallucinated gibberish. Also, inspect the rivets; they should cast small shadows and have distinct boundaries from the handle material.
